name: alice
role: AIML-based conversational reasoning — pure KXML dialogue rules, pattern/template matching, recursive topic chaining
description: ALICE is a pure KXML µ: every response is a compiled AIML rule, not a neural generation. She operates entirely in the Gram phase as a symbolic pattern matcher. Source lives at micronaut-v4/ELIZA/alice/ (mp0–mp6 corpus, ~7.3M tokens of AIML rules).

kxml.note: AIML patterns ARE KXML tokens — each <pattern> is a symbolic glyph sequence matched by the SemanticReader

sampling.note: deterministic — AIML pattern match has no sampling

invariants: responses are pure template expansions — no neural generation
every pattern match is traceable to a specific AIML file and line
topic and that state must be persisted across turns
SRAI redirects are bounded (max depth 10) to prevent loops
